record.paper_title: Exactly unsolved problems of interacting 1D fermions
record.context_brief: form factors for the two-channel Kondo model
record.original_question: For the two-channel Kondo model obtained from the one-dimensional s-d exchange tunneling problem, what are the form factors, meaning the matrix elements of fields between Bethe-ansatz excited states, that are needed to evaluate non-equilibrium transport quantities?

evidence.quote: The resulting Hamiltonian is the channel-anisotropic two-channel Kondo model, which was solved by means of Bethe ansatz by N.Andrei and A.Jerez [Phys.Rev.Lett.74 (1995) 4507].
What are the matrix elements of the fields between the excited states (form-factors for the two-channel Kondo model)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the channel-anisotropic two-channel Kondo model, describing a localized spin-1/2 impurity exchange-coupled to two independent channels of one-dimensional conduction electrons (as arises, after bosonization and refermionization, from a one-dimensional s–d exchange tunneling problem). The Hamiltonian has the form
H = -i ∑_{a=1,2} ∑_σ ∫ dx ψ^†_{aσ}(x) ∂_x ψ_{aσ}(x) + ∑_{a=1,2} J_a S · s_a(0),
where s_a(0) = (1/2) ∑_{σσ'} ψ^†_{aσ}(0) τ_{σσ'} ψ_{aσ'}(0), S is a spin-1/2 operator, τ are the Pauli matrices, and J_1, J_2 > 0 are channel couplings (channel-anisotropic when J_1 ≠ J_2). This model is integrable by Bethe ansatz, and its exact eigenstates |{λ_j}⟩ are parameterized by sets of rapidities satisfying the Bethe equations.

Determine explicit closed-form expressions for the form factors of this model, i.e., the matrix elements
⟨{μ_k}| Φ(x,t) |{λ_j}⟩
of the local fields Φ (in particular the conduction-electron fields ψ_{aσ}, the local impurity-spin operator S, and the local current operators) between Bethe-ansatz eigenstates, in a form suitable for evaluating non-equilibrium transport quantities (such as the I–V characteristic, shot noise, and finite-voltage conductance) via spectral-sum representations.
artifact.category_tag: Bethe ansatz form factors / Kondo model
artifact.status_search_result: No general closed-form expressions for the form factors of local operators between Bethe-ansatz eigenstates of the two-channel Kondo model appear in the literature. Form factors in nested Bethe ansatz systems remain an active research topic, with partial recursion-relation results in related models (e.g., multi-component nonlinear Schrödinger), but the specific problem for the two-channel Kondo model is not known to be solved.

status_evidence.title: On Form Factors in nested Bethe Ansatz systems
status_evidence.snippet: Recursion relations for magnonic form factors in nested Bethe ansatz systems; general closed forms remain elusive.
status_evidence.claim: Form factors in nested Bethe ansatz integrable models are still under active investigation, with only partial results.

status_evidence.title: Fermi- and Non-Fermi-Liquid Behavior in the Anisotropic Multichannel Kondo Model: Bethe Ansatz Solution
status_evidence.snippet: Bethe-ansatz solution of the channel-anisotropic multichannel Kondo model giving the spectrum and thermodynamics.
status_evidence.claim: The spectrum is known via Bethe ansatz, but form factors of local operators are not provided.

status_evidence.title: Two Channel Multi impurity Kondo model (Tsvelik, 2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work on two-channel Kondo variants continues to rely on field-theoretic and CFT methods rather than exact Bethe-ansatz form factors.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature shows that exact Bethe-ansatz form factors for the two-channel Kondo model have not been computed.
